claims.text: The paper focuses on end-to-end data-driven NLG methods, comparing three different approaches.
The evaluation includes a large number of automated metrics, such as word-overlap metrics and semantic similarity measures.
Grammar-based measures for evaluating readability and grammaticality are also considered for NLG evaluation.
The study highlights the need for novel evaluation methods that do not rely on ground-truth references.
